feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 August 2026 8:32am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 28 August 2026 at 8:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving area of low pressure over Britain, with associated troughs drifting northwards.


##Wind##

Between Southwest and Northwest today, initially 3 or 4, but increasing 4 or 5 over central and eastern parts of the area this afternoon and evening. Then falling Variable 2 to 4 in all waters tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight to moderate in the east for a time later today.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, then fair from later this morning or early afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any rain at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, settling East or Northeast 3 or 4 later tomorrow morning or afternoon, then backing North in the evening. Backing West 2 or 3 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle spreading from the south, clearing late tomorrow or overnight into Sunday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.
